name: prizm-checker
description: Audit a repo for alignment with the PRIZM design system and produce a diagnostic report with a % alignment score. Scores tokens (A1), component adoption (A2), and component fidelity (A3) today; composition (A4) and accessibility/contrast (A5) are part of the rubric but reported as not-yet-automated. Covers React/Next web products and JavaFX thick clients.
